navConvention: We use the standard quoted NAV: "NAV at Fair Value" (IDLC) / "NAV Per Unit at Market Price" (LankaBangla, Shanta). NAV-at-cost and buy/sell prices are ignored because they embed fees and are not comparable across funds.

sources.name: Shanta Asset Management Limited
sources.note: One fund page embeds the full daily NAV history since inception for all Shanta funds as JSON (__NEXT_DATA__), plus a DSE index series. Served by the AMC's own website.

sources.name: IDLC Asset Management Limited
sources.note: Historic NAV AJAX endpoint (admin/ajax_handle.php, request_type=historic_nav) returns the full available history per fund. Dividend history is not in this endpoint yet.

sources.name: LankaBangla Financial Portal
sources.note: Server-rendered weekly table of every open-end fund: latest NAV, prices, loads, AUM (in million BDT), inception month. Used for the roster and freshness/AUM metadata; its NAV archive API requires login, so NAV histories come from the AMCs directly.

fundMetaNotes: type and shariah come from each fund's own name and published description; they are our classification, not an AMC certification. fundSize is fetched weekly from the LankaBangla roster (AUM converted from million BDT to crore).
